assumptions: Domain enum summaries for ActorType, DisputeAction, DisputeStatus, Reason and TransactionKind now carry the Contracts text exactly (the text openapi.json renders); the Domain-only notes they replaced (glossary pointers, 'recorded, never used to decide', 'only card transactions can be disputed') are kept as a plain // line above each. Outcome and NotDisputableReason have no description in openapi.json before or after, so their Domain summaries are unchanged; member summaries do not reach the document.

Criterion 6 is applied beyond the nine enums in the files the story touches: no Contracts type now shares a name with a Domain or Application type, so Contracts.Disputes.* qualifications in CustomerView, OperationsView, RaiseDisputeHandler, CommitRows and four tests are written through their using, per conventions/backend.md:14. DisputeWire.cs also writes DisputeErrors and Error unqualified. Qualified names left untouched elsewhere (for example Domain.Disputes.DisputeErrors in DisputeWireErrorTests) are not enums and were not changed.

RaiseDisputeRequest keeps one qualified name, Domain.Disputes.Reason.WrongAmount: its property Reason is a Reason?, so C#'s Color Color rule does not apply and the simple name binds to the property. A comment says why; the AC6 source rule exempts that one file and proves it scans it.

The same stale comment criterion 4 names at RaiseDisputeRequest.cs:32 also sat on WithdrawDisputeRequest.NoteMaxLength and ResolveDisputeRequest.NoteMaxLength; all three now read 'Contracts uses Domain only for the enums identical on the wire (AD-1)'. The UsingAliasRulesTests summary was updated the same way; its rule is unchanged.

8.2's typed variant is DisputeWire.ActionNotAllowedWithDisputeStatus, already in Application on this base; it now takes the Domain DisputeStatus and its caller passes the status through. Domain/Disputes/DisputeErrors.cs has no System.Enum parameter on this base.

WireBytesTests.StoredData includes a SlaWarningRaised row (data {}), because it is a stored event type on this base. 8.14 removes that type: whichever of 8.14 and 8.17 merges second drops that one row (and StoredData_CoversEveryStoredEventTypeInTheDomain will fail until it does). StoredEventType was not touched.
